description: Addis Ababa Sheger Public Transport dataset is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. The dataset collated from 20 buses within one-year GPS data of each day, from 6:00 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. was collected from Sheger Public Transport Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The dataset has around 140,000 records of initial and destination with 123 routes. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
